create_dino_pretraining_config: create a DINO Swin-T pretraining config with mixed precision, GPU count, and number of epochs
create_dino_linear_eval_config: create a DINO linear evaluation config for ImageNet-1K using a pretraining checkpoint path and GPU count
run_config: run a VISSL integration test config in a temporary directory and return the training losses
test_pretraining_and_evaluation: test DINO Swin-T pretraining followed by linear evaluation on synthetic data with 2 GPUs
test_pretraining_preemption: test DINO pretraining checkpoint resumption by removing checkpoints and verifying loss convergence
